decision: Load Specs rows before observing their progress
rationale: The existing usable-filter requirement is violated by blocking full-session reads for every row. Compose lazy read-only compact observations in the UI, cancel old requests on navigation, and keep missing progress indeterminate. Preserve historical completion and explain current rechecks. No completion rules or plan acceptance change.

discovery.observation: All, Completed and Cancelled look unclickable and only appear after a long delay. Completed records also appear unfinished.
discovery.cause: The server-rendered list awaits every selected full session; the in-process implementation performs synchronous ledger and source scans, so Promise.all does not parallelize the work.
